constraints.definition: CHECK ((((char_length(full_name) >= 1) AND (char_length(full_name) <= 200)) AND (char_length(email) <= 254) AND (char_length(phone) <= 32) AND (char_length(address) <= 2000) AND (char_length(church_name) <= 200) AND (char_length(phone_country) <= 2) AND (char_length(phone_dial_code) <= 8) AND (char_length(profile_photo_url) <= 2048))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: profile_setup_details_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((birth_date IS NULL) OR ((birth_date >= '1900-01-01'::date) AND (birth_date <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila'::text))::date))) AND (residence_country ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text) AND (length(city) <= 100)))
